business_problem: lower the cost and complexity of loyalty analytics so Bond could process millions of daily transactions faster and package productized insights for clients securely.
solution_summary: Bond Brand Loyalty uses Snowflake and Snowflake Marketplace on Snowflake to lower the cost and complexity of loyalty analytics so bond could process millions of daily transactions faster and package productized insights for clients securely. Transactional, research, and partner data from Bond’s loyalty platform are centralized on Snowflake so the company can process and package insights more efficiently. The migration removes the cluster-management overhead of the prior managed Spark stack and keeps loyalty analytics, customer scoring, and application logic in one shared platform. Bond delivers those outputs through Synapze XI inside client Snowflake environments, where customers can combine loyalty data with their own profiles without exchanging raw data or compromising governance. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces copying, simplifies administration, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data for analytics, reporting, and AI....

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Marketplace
solution_components.role: Publishes or exchanges governed data products with customers or partners.

data_flow: transactional, research, and partner loyalty data flow into Snowflake and Snowflake Marketplace; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to Bond analysts, native apps, and client marketing teams.
business_outcome: Bond saved 50% by moving off managed Spark, improved client engagement by 7% with its Synapze XI native app, and created a simpler way to deliver privacy-preserving customer-360 loyalty insights.
